summary: SimEarth entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: SimEarth
entries.definitive_edition: Original computer release on period hardware or documented DOSBox/PCem setup

emulation.emulator: DOSBox, PCem, Basilisk II, or platform emulator for ports
emulation.notes: Use DOSBox/period computer route for primary; console emulators only for comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original computer build with manual/scenario/platform state documented

primary.version: Original computer release on DOSBox or period hardware
primary.why: SimEarth is a classic Maxis life-simulation game with many ports, but the computer releases are the best archive target for interface, simulation options, and capture. Console/CD versions are distinct ports and should be documented separately.
primary.how_to_play: Use the DOS/Mac/Windows classic computer release on period hardware or DOSBox/PCem. Record platform/version, manual/reference material, scenario, Gaia/simulation settings, speed, audio, save state, and whether SNES/Sega CD/TurboGrafx-CD ports were compared.

secondary.platform: SNES / Sega CD / TurboGrafx-CD / Amiga / Atari ST / Japanese computers
secondary.exclusive_content: Port-specific UI, audio, and presentation differences
secondary.why: Computer route is the simulation fidelity baseline.

all_releases.platform: SNES / Sega CD / TurboGrafx-CD / Amiga / Atari ST / FM Towns / PC-98 / X68000

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Many ports differ in UI and presentation; platform/version must be recorded.

entries.remaster_caveats: No current commercial remaster route is documented; record source and platform carefully.
